title: Digital engagement release product
description: A partner-published release of aggregate digital-engagement counts at country x month grain, with its manifest. One file per publish. Produced by the partner's own export job (reference implementation: Kavanah Analytics); validated and loaded by gc-kavanah-bridge into <https://data.global.church/kavanah/digital-engagement/>. Row fields carry an x-gc-term annotation naming the ontology term each maps to; nothing partner-specific lives on the rows. Nothing below country grain is representable in this schema.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the file was written against; the receiver accepts a named set of versions and refuses the rest.

grain.description: The grain in words. Country is the only geography; month is the only period. A consumer that finds any other value refuses the file.

suppression.description: No small-cell suppression and no restricted-country list at country grain (decided 2026-10-19): a country-level count of digital conversations locates no one. The partner's own choice of which teams and countries to include is the control.

sources.description: The partner sources the counts were computed from, one descriptor per source. Source particulars live here, never on the row fields: which sources feed which count, and what each source cannot place in a country.

oneOf.description: Echo conversations, keyed on the seeker's country and the conversation's activity month. The only source of touchpoints and active.
Google Ads geographic impressions and clicks by country (feeds exposed and interactions).
Google Analytics 4 sessions by country (feeds interactions).
YouTube Analytics views by country (feeds exposed).

Facebook Ads impressions and clicks from ad sets targeting exactly one country (feeds exposed and interactions); ad sets targeting several countries are not split and are reported under manifest.unattributed.

countriesIncluded.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes the workspace owner chose to publish. Every row's countryIso2 is in this list. A country present in the partner's data but not in this list was left out by the owner and is simply absent; consumers render it as 'no contribution reported', never as 'withheld'.

orgUri.description: The Global.Church directory URI of the contributing organisation (https://data.global.church/org/<slug>). Every cell is attributed to it.

partnerOrgId.description: The partner system's own identifier for the organisation (Kavanah: the de_asset_organization document id). Carried for the partner's reconciliation; never rendered.

named.description: Whether the organisation chose to be named on the map. false renders as 'a contributing ministry'.

name.description: The name to show when named is true. Required when named is true; must be absent when named is false.

firstMonth.description: Earliest month covered by the release (inclusive).

lastMonth.description: Latest month covered by the release (inclusive).

id.description: Stable identifier of the data-sharing agreement text (e.g. digital-aggregates).

version.description: Version of the agreement text that was accepted.

sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex, lower-case) of the agreement text as accepted, so the receiver can prove which words were agreed to.

acceptedAt.description: When the workspace owner accepted the agreement (ISO 8601, UTC).

acceptedByRole.description: The role in the partner system that accepted. No person is named in the release.

exposed.description: Impressions that could not be placed in a country: Facebook ad sets targeting more than one country (the importer holds no per-country delivery breakdown). Never split across countries.

interactions.description: Clicks that could not be placed in a country, same rule.

unattributed.description: Counts the exporter could not assign to a single country (for example an ad set targeting several countries). Reported so the owner and the receiver know what is missing from the rows; never distributed across countries.

generatedAt.description: When the export job produced the file (ISO 8601, UTC).

generatedBy.description: The producing software and version, e.g. 'kavanah-analytics export_release_product 0.1.0'.

testData.description: true when the release is synthetic (a demo or test workspace). Consumers label such releases as test data everywhere they appear.

rows.description: One row per team label x country x month. Rows for the same team, country and month must not repeat.

team.description: The partner's team label under the organisation. Carried for provenance; confidential, never rendered.

countryIso2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the country the audience or seeker was in. Never the publishing team's own country.
countryIso2.x-gc-term: at:countryCode (resolved to the HIS ROG code on load)

countryIso3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 of the same country, written beside alpha-2 because the receiver's country registry (HIS ROG) is keyed differently from ISO-2 and resolves on alpha-3.
countryIso3.x-gc-term: at:countryCode (the join key used to resolve the HIS ROG code)

exposed.description: People exposed to content in the cell: impressions and views, summed over the exposure sources listed in manifest.sources. Ad-platform figures with cross-account overlap; not de-duplicated across sources.

interactions.description: Interactions with content in the cell: clicks and sessions, summed over the interaction sources listed in manifest.sources.

touchpoints.description: Conversations started in the cell, keyed on the seeker's country, from the conversation sources listed in manifest.sources.

active.description: Conversations in the cell with a spiritual-conversation or multiplier outcome. Always <= touchpoints.
